title: Lean Kernel Arena Checker Configuration
description: Schema for checker YAML configuration files

version.description: Version identifier for the checker. If omitted but both `ref` and `rev` are present, the arena will display `ref (rev7)` where `rev7` is the last 7 characters of `rev`.

description.description: Multi-line description of the checker (supports Pandoc Markdown)

ref.description: Git branch or tag to checkout

dir.description: Local directory path relative to checkers/ directory

build.description: Shell command to build the checker

run.description: Shell command to run the checker. $IN variable points to input test file

timeout.description: Time limit in seconds for running the checker on any one test. Where the test sets a time limit too, the smaller one applies. A checker exceeding it is killed and the result is recorded with status 'timeout' (treated like an error, i.e. as declined). Set this rather than wrapping the run command in `timeout`, which the arena could not kill reliably.

disable.description: If true, this checker will be ignored and not built or run

declines.description: Test name or list of test names that this checker declines without running them (recorded as declined, as if the checker had exited with code 2)

threads.description: Worker threads the checker runs concurrently; the parallel runner reserves this many CPU slots to avoid oversubscribing (default: 1)
